_comment: Repository-level Actions variables. PRODUCTION_URL is read by .github/workflows/merge-on-healthy.yml, which uses it to say WHY it cannot re-derive guard 5 from a runner. EMERGENCY_CHANGE is the freeze fallback read by gates/preflight.sh when the change calendar is unreachable (spec.org, Change enablement): EMERGENCY_CHANGE=1 blocks the estate, 0 is the normal resting value. DEPLOY_TARGET was removed with the forge-side deploy workflows (ADR 0004) -- it was set to `github`, there has never been a targets/github/, and nothing else read it. Delete it from the repository with .github/config/apply.sh; a declared variable nothing reads is dead config that reads as coverage.
